Reference generators and judges support evidence construction; they do not
directly rank candidate IDs. The dated July 21 review recommends Gemini 3.6
Flash as the primary API reference generator, Qwen3.6-27B as the preferred
local retry, Gemma 4 31B-it as a model-family control, and Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite
only for high-volume mechanical judging after calibration.

Those are planning recommendations based on official provider documentation,
published general benchmarks, cost envelopes, and local runtime evidence.
General MMLU-Pro, GPQA, HLE, throughput, and price comparisons do not establish
reference quality on this question mix. The controlling report requires a
reviewed pilot before adopting a generator or judge.

Provider model changes, dated prices, and a failed local backend are operational
facts, not organizer judgments and not candidate-ranking results. The report
therefore separates verified documentation from hardware-fit and task-fit
inferences and calls for cheap readiness canaries before substantial local runs.
